orchestkit · the #959 / #1264 class

The last blind surface, and it was clean

66 hook references live in skill and agent frontmatter. Nothing checked any of them. Every one resolves, so this adds a gate rather than a fix. The interesting part is what it took to believe that, after a day where four separate guards reported clean because they could not see.

66
references, all resolving
0
unknown prefixes
0
unregistered names
3
controls required to trust it

Two silent failure modes

run-hook.mjs resolves the frontmatter string in three steps

  "run-hook.mjs skill/assessment-baseline-loader"
        │
        ├─ prefix  = "skill"
        ├─ bundle  = bundleMap[prefix]      unknown -> SILENT EXIT
        └─ handler = hooks[full name]       missing -> SILENT EXIT

Neither miss reports anything. The hook simply never runs. That is how #1264 happened: instructions-loaded, elicitation and config-change existed in the lifecycle bundle but had no prefix mapping, so they were born dead and stayed dead for about three months. The comment recording it is still in run-hook.mjs.

Why a clean result needed three controls

ControlInjectedResult
Aa hook name nobody registerscaught, exit 1
Ba prefix not in bundleMapcaught, exit 1
Cone entry bundle made unreadablecaught, exit 1, names the file

Control C failed to fire on the first attempt, and that was the control being wrong rather than the check working: the pattern export const hooks[^=]*= also matches export const hooksRENAMED, so the rename kept passing. Anchoring on the colon fixed a real looseness that would have let a renamed bundle go unnoticed. Control C now reports 193 registered instead of 199, which is the proof that the reading is real.

The self-check is part of the gate

this file refuses to report SUCCESS on an empty reading

  prefixes    == 0   -> FAIL  "blind, not clean"
  registered  == 0   -> FAIL  "blind, not clean"
  references  == 0   -> FAIL  "blind, not clean"
  any bundle yields 0 names -> FAIL, and names the bundle

Four guards touched today reported clean because they could not see: a linter matching one of two YAML list shapes, a coverage metric counting non-resolving declarations as proof of reachability, and two throwaway parsers. "Found nothing" and "looked at nothing" are indistinguishable from outside, so a gate that cannot prove it read something is worth less than no gate.

Sources of truth, not copies

The prefix list is parsed out of run-hook.mjs's own bundleMap, and the 199 hook names out of entries/*.ts. Hardcoding either would create a fourth thing to drift, which is the disease rather than the cure.
